verdict.rationale: Homebrew exposes a JSON API (homebrew-docs-70 references `brew info --json` listings on formulae.brew.sh), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows API versioning or a documented deprecation policy for it, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec. Community comments about Intel support deprecation concern hardware support, not API deprecation, so they do not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
